label: Outcomes of pediatric median arcuate ligament release: A single-center experience.
summary: Median arcuate ligament syndrome (MALS) is a rare condition caused by compression of the celiac artery by the median arcuate ligament. The surgical treatment for MALS is a median arcuate ligament release (MALR). While outcomes of MALR are well described in adults, pediatric data remain limited.
